spark_open.description: The creature is shown in right-facing profile walking on a plain light background. It has a stout, arched quadrupedal body with a pale pink, smooth-skinned head and underside and a back, sides, top of the head, outer limbs and dorsal tail densely covered in large overlapping brown scales. The head is broad and flat with a blunt snout, large dark eyes with pale irises, and a slight upturned mouth. Six pink feathery external gills protrude from the sides and top of the neck just behind the head. The four limbs are thick and columnar, pale and wrinkled on the inner and ventral surfaces, scaled on the outer surfaces, ending in broad clawed feet. A thick tapering tail extends to the left rear, pale below and scaled above, partially out of frame. The overall appearance combines a scaled armored back with a soft amphibian-like head, belly and limbs.

meta_spark.description: A stout four-legged creature shown in right-facing three-quarter view with an arched body. The back, top of the head, upper legs and top of the tail are covered in overlapping large rounded dark brown scales like armor, while the face, sides of the neck, belly, lower legs, feet and underside of the tail are pale pinkish-white wrinkled skin. The head is broad, flat and rounded with a slight smile, small nostrils, and large round eyes, with six pink feathery external gill stalks protruding from the sides of the head. It stands on four short thick clawed feet and has a long tapering tail extending to the left.
